description: Bundled knowledge packs that are auto-imported on first run

packs.name: Core Tutorials
packs.description: Essential getting started tutorials for Mossy

packs.name: 4estGimp Donated Files — Fallout 4 Patch Database
packs.description: Knowledge from 4estGimp's personally donated PDF files — first 400 entries of their Fallout 4 patch and compatibility database. Gifted to Mossy by 4estGimp (https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/users/30343500).

packs.name: Fallout 4 Vanilla Asset Paths & Archive Map
packs.description: Ground-truth vanilla Data\ directory and BA2 archive organization (decal meshes, impact FX, top-level Meshes\ map, asset lookup workflow) verified directly against the installed game's BA2 archives.

packs.name: Fallout 4 Popular Mods & Compatibility Database
packs.description: Curated database of the most-installed Fallout 4 mods, usage rates, known conflicts, and compatibility tips for mod authors.

packs.name: Fallout 4 Technical Reference (Papyrus, Records, FormIDs, NIF, Console)
packs.description: Structured technical reference: Papyrus script templates, CK record field schemas, FormID ranges, NIF block types, console commands, common error fixes, xEdit script templates.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Lore, Story & Factions
packs.description: Comprehensive Fallout 4 lore: pre-war history, The Great War, main story arc, all four major factions (Minutemen, Brotherhood, Railroad, Institute), other factions, key characters, and Commonwealth geography.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Game Mechanics & Systems
packs.description: Complete game mechanics: full SPECIAL stat & perk chart, V.A.T.S. and combat, Survival Mode rules, settlement building & workshop system, all crafting systems, all companions with affinity, leveling & XP, Power Armor.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Locations Database
packs.description: Full Commonwealth location database: north, downtown Boston, Cambridge/south, key interior cells, vaults, and all 30 settlement locations including DLC.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Weapons, Armor & Items Database
packs.description: Complete weapon database (ballistic, energy, melee), all armor types, legendary effects, unique/named weapons, all chems and consumables.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Quest Database
packs.description: Full quest database: main quest all stages with setstage IDs, major side quests, Minutemen questline, and notable misc/hidden quests.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete DLC Guide
packs.description: All six DLCs covered in depth: Automatron (robot building, Mechanist), Wasteland Workshop (cages, arena), Far Harbor (DiMA, factions, fog island), Contraptions Workshop (manufacturing), Vault-Tec Workshop (Vault 88), Nuka-World (raider gangs, Open Season).

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Complete Enemy & Creature Database
packs.description: Full bestiary: all wildlife and mutated creatures, human factions (Raiders, Gunners, Super Mutants, Ghouls), all robot types with weaknesses and loot.

packs.name: Fallout 4 — Advanced Modding Guide
packs.description: Advanced modding: Creation Kit workflows (navmesh, quests, ESL), F4SE plugin ecosystem (Buffout 4, Address Library, MCM), load order management (LOOT, MO2, xEdit), texture/BA2 modding, and common bug fixes.
